verified_facts.text: The hotel is at No. 1 Promenade des Anglais in Nice, with garden and sea views.
verified_facts.excerpt: Occupying a prime position at No.1 Promenade des Anglais, Le Méridien Nice has a legendary French Riviera location, with exceptional garden and sea views.

verified_facts.text: The hotel sits between Nice Old Town, the Promenade des Anglais and the shopping district.
verified_facts.excerpt: our hotel with a sea view is perfectly positioned between Nice Old Town, Promenade des Anglais and the shopping district

verified_facts.text: Rooms and suites have modern interiors with a mid-century aesthetic.
verified_facts.excerpt: Featuring modern interiors with a mid-century aesthetic, each guest room and suite has been fashioned to reveal a new perspective on the Côte d’Azur.

verified_facts.text: Room decor uses sandy tones, asymmetric furniture, leather braiding, wicker, raffia and driftwood.
verified_facts.excerpt: Sandy tones, asymmetric furniture, leather braiding, wicker, raffia and driftwood all add a sense of place.

verified_facts.text: Select rooms have balconies and views of the Mediterranean Sea or the Baie des Anges.
verified_facts.excerpt: with select balconies and Mediterranean Sea or Baie des Anges views

verified_facts.text: The Panoramic Suite has a spacious corner terrace with teak loungers overlooking the sea.
verified_facts.excerpt: Step outside to experience the pièce de résistance, a spacious corner terrace where teak loungers overlook the extraordinary seascape.

verified_facts.text: The Presidential Suite has the largest private terrace in the hotel, overlooking the Promenade des Anglais and the Mediterranean Sea.
verified_facts.excerpt: Offering the largest private terrace in the hotel, the Presidential Suite overlooks the Promenade des Anglais and the Mediterranean Sea.

verified_facts.text: The Presidential Suite features three artworks by local artist Guillaume Cavalier.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Presidential Suite offers breathtaking views of the Baie des Anges and features three exclusive artworks by local artist Guillaume Cavalier.

verified_facts.text: The Mediterranean Suite was redesigned by Galeries Lafayette with AM.PM furniture and a curated selection of accessories.
verified_facts.excerpt: Stay in the Mediterranean Suite, fully redesigned by Galeries Lafayette with AM.PM furniture and a curated selection of accessories.

verified_facts.text: In the Mediterranean Suite, a personal shopper can come directly to the suite.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy an exclusive service with a personal shopper who comes directly to your suite for a bespoke shopping experience.

verified_facts.text: The rooftop swimming pool is open year-round with the Mediterranean Sea as its backdrop.
verified_facts.excerpt: The rooftop swimming pool at Le Méridien Nice is a year-round destination with the Mediterranean Sea as an iconic backdrop.

verified_facts.text: The rooftop pool is heated.
verified_facts.excerpt: Take a Dip in the Heated Rooftop Pool

verified_facts.text: Elaïo is the highest restaurant on the Promenade des Anglais, with a panorama over the Baie des Anges.
verified_facts.excerpt: As the highest restaurant on La Promenade des Anglais, Elaïo offers a breathtaking panorama over the Baie des Anges

verified_facts.text: Elaïo serves Mediterranean cuisine inspired by the olive, with panoramic sea views.
verified_facts.excerpt: Elaïo celebrates Mediterranean cuisine inspired by the olive, served with panoramic sea views.

verified_facts.text: Latitude Bar was designed by Saguez & Partners in collaboration with designer and interior architect Didier Gomez.
verified_facts.excerpt: The bar comes from the creative brains of Saguez & Partners in collaboration with celebrated designer and interior architect, Didier Gomez.

verified_facts.text: The breakfast room, L'Espace Riviera, evokes a classic seaside villa with wood-paneled walls, rattan hanging lights and trompe-l'oeil palms.
verified_facts.excerpt: L’Espace Riviera evokes a classic seaside villa with wood-paneled walls, rattan hanging lights and trompe-l’oeil palms.

verified_facts.text: The 10th-floor rooftop has a fresco by local artist Django.
verified_facts.excerpt: Discover on our 10th-floor rooftop the unique fresco by local artist Django, blending vibrant strokes and face deconstruction to reveal emotion.

verified_facts.text: The lobby hosts an exhibition by local artist SAB featuring her blue chair, a symbol of the Promenade des Anglais.
verified_facts.excerpt: Explore an exclusive exhibition by local artist SAB in the lobby of Le Méridien Nice, featuring her iconic blue chair, a symbol of the Promenade des Anglais.

verified_facts.text: Le Méridien Hub overlooks the Mediterranean Sea and combines reception, co-working space and bar in an open-plan setting.
verified_facts.excerpt: Overlooking the Mediterranean Sea, this unique backdrop is where guests gather and connect in an open plan setting, combining Reception, co-working space and bar.

verified_facts.text: A living wall inside Le Méridien Hub reflects the lush Mediterranean landscape.
verified_facts.excerpt: Designed to reflect the lush Mediterranean landscape, the living wall located inside Le Méridien Hub transports guests to a tropical paradise.

verified_facts.text: Families can choose spacious suites, family rooms and interconnecting rooms.
verified_facts.excerpt: Families can enjoy spacious suites, family rooms in Nice and interconnecting rooms availability

verified_facts.text: Each marble en-suite bathroom has an illuminated mirror and premium products.
verified_facts.excerpt: Styled in marble, each en-suite bathroom has an illuminated mirror and premium products.

verified_facts.text: Rooms include a complimentary Nespresso machine, bottled water and internet.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy complimentary amenities, including a Nespresso machine, bottled water and internet.

verified_facts.text: Guests can watch the sunset from the hotel's beachfront.
verified_facts.excerpt: For captivating sunsets, step onto the hotel’s beachfront and watch in awe as the sun goes down.

verified_facts.text: Bicycle and e-scooter rental is available on site.
verified_facts.excerpt: Bicycle and e-scooter rental on-site make it simple to discover more attractions

verified_facts.text: The hotel team created a map of the city's attractions and local spots, available at reception or on a smartphone.
verified_facts.excerpt: Pick up a copy at reception or download on a smartphone

verified_facts.text: Pets are welcome.
verified_facts.excerpt: Pets Welcome.

verified_facts.text: The gym is open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
verified_facts.excerpt: Open 7 days a week, 24 hours a day

verified_facts.text: Nice Côte d'Azur Airport is approximately 6 km from the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: NCE is located approximately 6.0 KM from the hotel.

verified_facts.text: An Interparking car park is located right underneath the hotel in the same building.
verified_facts.excerpt: Interparking is located right underneath the hotel in the same building
